displayDescription: A folded idea card opens and kraft strips unroll, connecting cardboard boxes that fold up from flat nets on a green cutting mat.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186.1 WebGLRenderer (local node_modules, bundled with esbuild into paper-scene.js)
Canvas 2D seeded procedural textures (paper/kraft fibers, corrugated flutes, cutting-mat grid)
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline (sole owner of all animated state)
Procedural Paper Curl and Fold Deformation (CPU BufferGeometry deformation from immutable rest vertices: card crease fold, strip unroll coil)
Rigid hinge pivots for constant-thickness cardboard walls and lid flaps
limitations: Blender, bpy, Cycles and EEVEE were not used, per user instruction. Three.js real-time shading (MeshStandardMaterial, PCF soft shadows) approximates Cycles soft paper lighting, without true subsurface transmission or global illumination.
The paper fold and strip coil are artistic arc-length-preserving deformations, not a physical paper solver. Card stock is a single-sided surface with no modeled thickness.
Cardboard panels are rigid boxes with constant thickness. Corner joints overlap slightly rather than being modeled as exact glued tabs.
Fiber, corrugation and grid detail come from seeded procedural Canvas textures, not photographs.

No preview_recipes were listed in STYLE.json, and BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json has 0 matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied. The green cutting-mat background is a scene-dependent choice made from the craft-table environment.

Title uses the OS-bundled Impact font via @font-face local('Impact'), with Arial Black declared the same way as a fallback. No font files are bundled, so typography depends on these system fonts being present on the render host.
